results.title: Boart Longyear Ltd. - AnnualReports.com
results.snippet: Boart Longyear Limited provides drilling services, drilling equipment, and performance tooling for mining and mineral drilling companies worldwide. The company operates through two divisions, Global Drilling Services and Global Products.

results.title: Boart Longyear Pty Limited - Enterprise Profile | IBISWorld
results.snippet: Boart Longyear Limited divides its operation into the following three business units: Global Drilling Services - The company provides surface drilling, underground, and water drilling services for a number of industries, and is also engaged in the provision of environmental, health & safety programs and training.
